title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israeli sports headlines — football comebacks, a basketball MVP's new deal, and a World Cup final for the ages.

questions.question: Which club did Manor Solomon start for on the right wing in a 22 July 2026 pre-season friendly against MK Dons?
questions.explanation: Solomon started for Tottenham at Hotspur Way as they beat MK Dons 1-0, playing the first half before Roberto De Zerbi's mass substitutions.

questions.question: Who scored the only goal, a third-minute volley, as Tottenham beat MK Dons 1-0 in pre-season?
questions.explanation: Summer signing Mateus Fernandes volleyed home after MK Dons keeper Craig MacGillivray could only punch clear a Mathys Tel corner.

questions.question: Which Danish guard was named Finals MVP as Maccabi Tel Aviv won its 58th Israeli championship, and has now agreed a new contract to stay?
questions.explanation: Lundberg averaged 14.1 points, 5.1 assists and 3.3 rebounds in the playoffs and was named Finals MVP as Maccabi beat Hapoel Tel Aviv 3-1.

questions.question: Which 19-year-old Barcelona and Spain centre-back was named FIFA's Young Player of the Tournament after Spain's extra-time win over Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final?
questions.explanation: Cubarsí led the final with six clearances and made a decisive late goal-line block as Spain won 1-0 after extra time.

questions.question: According to Sport5's new valuation model, which Ligat Ha'al club was ranked Israel's most valuable ahead of the new season?
questions.explanation: Maccabi Haifa topped the rankings at an estimated €83.8 million, just ahead of Maccabi Tel Aviv's €79.85 million.
